description: This is a main source file for a FastAPI backend application for a notes app. It includes API endpoint definitions for health checks and CRUD operations on in-memory notes, along with application setup including middleware configuration.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a note with id, title, and content

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new note, with optional content

methods.name: create_app
methods.description: Creates and configures the FastAPI application instance, including route definitions and middleware.

methods.name: healthz
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple status message.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Returns the list of all notes stored in-memory.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note and appends it to the in-memory store.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a note by ID, or raises a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, or raises a 404 error if not found.
